Sign-in is not in this version
Account spend stays on the server and is not sent without a sign-in. This app does not use the network.

Checked on 8 Nov 2026 against tokeny.martinpohl.cz: the summary without a sign-in returns 401, a session without a cookie is null, and minting a JWT without a session returns 401. A Neon Auth JWT is minted only for a browser session and it is short-lived. This app does not copy a browser cookie.

A personal MCP token, which starts with orm_, is Pro only and can do more than read the summary. It does not belong on the phone. Do not type Anthropic, OpenAI, or OpenRouter keys here. The app does not store them and has nowhere safe to send them.
When a mobile sign-in is agreed, the summary will come only from the existing usage-summary API. This version will not pretend that it already does.
